takes.text: Hành trình của bà đã kết thúc. Hành trình của con bắt đầu từ đây.
takes.style: Scene: The finale: a swirl of paper and fabric carries Tí into the story. Bà blesses the listener softly: her journey ends, theirs begins. Speaker: Bà, Tí's 75-year-old grandmother from Kinh Bắc, a retired seamstress; warm, slow, tender, wise, a quiet smile in her voice. Delivery: Serene and gentle, saying goodbye with a smile. Then: Warm, clear and encouraging, a blessing to the listener; slightly stronger. Speak Vietnamese with a natural Northern accent. Leave a short natural pause between sentences.
